title: Starter Camp
description: data/starterCamp.json, and the workspace's starterCamp: the layout a new game starts with. Its one reader is normaliseStarterCamp (src/config/starterCampShape.js), which drops malformed lines rather than refusing them; the game's loader is src/config/registries/starterCampRegistry.js. Authored on the CMS's Starter Camp page (cms/src/components/starterCamp/StarterCampPage.jsx) from the game's Save this mat button. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings.

savedAt.description: When the game saved the layout.

mat.description: The mat it was saved from, in mat units; the game recentres the layout on the mat it opens on.

tokens.description: Every placed Token but the Guild Hall and quest Tokens.

bank.description: The Bank it starts with: item id to a whole number above zero.

banner.description: The area banner it shows (src/config/areaBanners.js); without one the game picks by biome.
